# Redemption International School (RIS)

> Redemption International School is a distinguished international Christian school situated in Munyonyo, Kampala, Uganda. RIS is dedicated to unlocking each student's potential through academic excellence, spiritual foundation, and future-ready 21st-century skills.

## Core Curricula & Programs
- **ACE (Accelerated Christian Education)**: Individualized, mastery-based Christian education emphasizing self-paced learning, biblical character building, and academic mastery from preschool through high school.
- **Cambridge International**: Rigorous global curriculum following Cambridge Primary, Lower Secondary, IGCSE, and AS/A Levels, developing analytical thinking and international qualifications.
- **CBC (Competency-Based Curriculum)**: Kenya's learner-centered curriculum focused on real-world application, critical thinking, problem-solving, and personal talents.
- **Robotics & STEM**: Hands-on robotics, coding, Lego Education, and STEM engineering preparing students for technological innovation.
- **Multilingual Education**: Comprehensive language acquisition in German, French, Spanish, and Kiswahili.

## Admissions & Enrollment
- Admissions are open year-round for early learning, primary, junior high, and high school.
- Applications can be submitted online via the admissions portal or directly on campus.

## Contact Information
- **Location**: Munyonyo, Kampala, Uganda
- **Website**: https://redemptioninternationalschool.com
